_note: v2.4 plan 01 guidance, LIVE (real model, profile selected, no debugResponse). Every non-dry GENERATE_AFTER_DATA request is recorded with the checkpoint active when it was built and the generation type. A normal request on a checkpoint that authors guidance must carry that guidance; a request on a guidance-less checkpoint and an impersonate request must carry no 'Scene direction:' block. The over-steer probe measures reply N+1 on cp-4a against a control reply to the same player line on cp2 (no guidance); the swing is recorded, never gated. Real extraction runs, so the story may move between turns: each assertion reads the checkpoint recorded per request, never a fixed id. Run with --sandbox --group 1759606632088.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const probe = globalThis.__soGuidanceProbe = { requests: [], type: null }; ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATION_STARTED, (type, params, dryRun) => { if (!dryRun && typeof type === 'string') probe.type = type; }); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, (data, dryRun) => { if (dryRun) return; const active = rt.getEngineState()?.activeCheckpointId ?? null; probe.requests.push({ type: probe.type, active, guidance: rt.getStory()?.checkpointById?.[active]?.guidance ?? null, body: JSON.stringify(data ?? null) }); }); return { installed: true };

steps.eval: const box = document.querySelector('#send_textarea'); const drafted = box ? box.value : ''; if (box) { box.value = ''; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } const probe = globalThis.__soGuidanceProbe; const normal = probe.requests.filter((r) => r.type !== 'impersonate' && r.type !== 'quiet'); const impersonate = probe.requests.filter((r) => r.type === 'impersonate'); const guided = normal.filter((r) => r.guidance); const bare = normal.filter((r) => !r.guidance); if (!guided.length) throw new Error('no normal request was built on a checkpoint that authors guidance: ' + JSON.stringify(normal.map((r) => r.active))); if (!bare.length) throw new Error('no normal request was built on a guidance-less checkpoint (the control arm)'); if (!impersonate.length) throw new Error('/impersonate produced no recorded request'); const missing = guided.filter((r) => !r.body.includes(r.guidance)); if (missing.length) throw new Error('a request on a guided checkpoint does not carry its guidance: ' + JSON.stringify(missing.map((r) => r.active))); const leaked = [...bare, ...impersonate].filter((r) => r.body.includes('Scene direction:')); if (leaked.length) throw new Error('a request that must carry no guidance does: ' + JSON.stringify(leaked.map((r) => ({ type: r.type, active: r.active })))); return { guided: guided.map((r) => r.active), bare: bare.map((r) => r.active), impersonate: impersonate.map((r) => r.active), drafted: drafted.slice(0, 80) };
